description: Return what's playing and what's up next on a speaker. Powers 'what's playing in the living room?' and 'what's next?' questions.
name: mass_get_queue

description: Enumerate Music Assistant players (speakers). Returns `player_id`, `display_name`, `available`, `powered`, `state`, `volume_level`, and `current_item`. Hidden players are excluded unless `include_hidden=true`. Use the `display_name` values as `player_name` inputs to other tools.

include_hidden.description: Include players that MA has flagged hide_in_ui (e.g. the web player). Default false.

name: mass_list_players

description: Play a short audio announcement URL on a speaker. Ducks any currently playing track on Music Assistant's side and resumes it when the announcement finishes. Used by the autonomy engine's `speak` delivery channel to play TTS on ESP32 satellites / Chromecasts / Google Homes. `player_name` is a display_name from mass_list_players. `volume` is 0.0-1.0 (or 0-100 percent).

pre_announce.description: Optional — play MA's chime before the clip. Defaults to MA's player setting.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL to the audio clip. Must be reachable from the MA host.

volume.description: Optional volume (0.0-1.0 float or 0-100 int). Defaults to MA's configured announcement level.

name: mass_play_announcement

description: Play a media item on a speaker. `uri` comes from a prior mass_search result. `player_name` is a speaker display_name from mass_list_players (partial match accepted). `mode` controls queue behavior: 'replace' (default — clear queue, play now), 'next' (insert after current), 'add' (append to end).

uri.description: MA URI from a prior search result.

name: mass_play_media

description: Queue-level actions beyond basic pause/resume (which stay on ha_control_media_player). Supported: 'shuffle_on', 'shuffle_off', 'repeat_off', 'repeat_one', 'repeat_all'.
name: mass_playback_control

description: Empty the queue on a speaker and stop playback.
name: mass_queue_clear

description:
Search the Music Assistant library across all connected providers (Plex, Spotify, etc.) for tracks/albums/artists/playlists/radio. Returns rows with `uri` (opaque — pass to mass_play_media), `name`, `artist`, `album`, `media_type`, and `providers`.

Query tip: MA's search is title-biased. Prefer a single short query (a title OR an artist, not both in one string). The server will auto-fallback if a typed search misses, but the cleanest result comes from concise queries like 'The Better Life' or '3 Doors Down'.
name: mass_search
